executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from urllib.parse import urljoin
import json,hashlib,re,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_original_archive_route_probe_v1');base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
src=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_multidimensional_cash_constraint_source_v1/sources/industrial_FAQ.html')
raw=src.read_bytes();soup=BeautifulSoup(raw.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser')
links=[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'raw_href':a['href'],'absolute_url':urljoin('https://www.stats.gov.cn/hd/cjwtjd/202302/t20230207_1902277.html',a['href'])} for a in soup.select('a[href]') if a.get_text(' ',strip=True)=='公开']
assert any(x['absolute_url']=='https://www.stats.gov.cn/gk/' for x in links)
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def dump(name,x):
 p=base/name;assert not p.exists()
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
proto={'study_id':'510300_INDUSTRIAL_DISTINCT_OFFICIAL_HISTORICAL_ARCHIVE_ACTUAL_NAVIGATION_ROUTE_V1','experiment_id':'E90','registered_at':now(),'basis':'E89真实目录有限路线仅41/79原发布，缺失38期/全池0；来源阶段无金融失败，寻找不同官方历史原载体导航，不重试现目录受检/失败URL','same_full_target_79_and_original1711_and1212_preserved':True,'prior_route_frozen_failure':'reports/research/510300_industrial_cash_constraint_original_panel_v1/result_v1_0_1.json','first_actual_href_evidence':{'raw_path':src.as_posix(),'raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'actual_original_links':links},'source_route_budget':{'distinct_actual_original_GETs_max':4,'queries':0,'web_opens':0,'raw_GET_retries':0,'authentication':0,'allowed':'已原FAQ实际公开链接到官网公开入口，再仅其真实链接、iframe或明确目录脚本定义跟踪旧数据发布/历史公开索引，URL不猜；遇校验/失败不重试、不执行校验脚本'},'financial_status':'NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','new_linear_regressions_budget':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores_budget':0,'new_model_fits_budget':0,'new_stock_labels_budget':0,'new_accounts_budget':0,'source_code_edits_budget':0,'goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET'}
dump('protocol.json',proto)
url='https://www.stats.gov.cn/gk/'
ledger=base/'实际原公开导航GET账本.jsonl'
def trace(x):
 with ledger.open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n');f.flush()
trace({'at':now(),'event':'REQUEST_STARTED','url':url,'attempt':1})
out={'requested_url':url,'started_at':now(),'actual_original_GETs':1,'raw_GET_retries':0}
try:
 r=requests.get(url,timeout=(10,30));p=base/'sources';p.mkdir(exist_ok=True);html=p/'actual_government_open_root.html';html.write_bytes(r.content)
 s=BeautifulSoup(r.content.decode('utf-8-sig',errors='replace'),'html.parser');full=s.get_text('\n',strip=True)
 out.update(status_code=r.status_code,final_url=r.url,path=html.as_posix(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest(),bytes=len(r.content),status='BROWSER_CHECK_ONLY' if 'Please enable JavaScript and refresh the page.' in full else ('ORIGINAL_PAGE' if r.status_code==200 else 'HTTP_FAILED'))
 out['all_actual_links']=[{'text':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'raw_href':a['href'],'absolute_url':urljoin(r.url,a['href'])} for a in s.select('a[href]')]
 out['all_actual_iframes']=[{'src':a['src'],'absolute_url':urljoin(r.url,a['src'])} for a in s.select('iframe[src]')]
 out['scripts']=[{'src':a.get('src'),'body':a.get_text()[:20000]} for a in s.select('script') if a.get('src') or 'xxgk' in a.get_text() or 'location' in a.get_text()]
except Exception as e:out.update(status='GET_FAILED_NO_RETRY',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e))
out['completed_at']=now()
trace({'event':'REQUEST_FINISHED',**{k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['all_actual_links','all_actual_iframes','scripts']}})
dump('第一原公开入口实际读取.json',out)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k not in ['all_actual_links','scripts']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
print('实际相关原锚',json.dumps([a for a in out.get('all_actual_links',[]) if any(x in a['text'] for x in ['公开','发布','数据','历史']) or 'xxgk' in a['absolute_url']],ensure_ascii=False)[:7000],flush=True)
